Immediately after the quoted on-track statement, Sanjiv Lamba identified 2030 as the timeline for the 'billion-plus' space expectation and said separate end-market disclosure would follow once the business reached sufficient size.

Management reported increased space-propellant activity, but said rare-gas sales for satellite propulsion had softened because customer payloads were awaiting launch. The call did not update the $1 billion target or its 2030 timing.
